locations.title: Old Verse 20
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"Once it shone upon us all, with all the warmth of welcome sun.  "But now we weep, to grief we fall, starved of light now it has gone.  
"And some they go, despair withal, in search of it they reel and run.  
"They quit their hearths, abandon hall, and leave our lands to be undone.  
"And when they're gone beyond recall, this land will be a home to none. This land will only ever be a home to Pokémon."

locations.title: Old Verse 19
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"When first this land was formed, man and 'mon lived happily, sharing all that they could see, by kind acts born and warmed.  
"One Pokémon then proposed that they should always ready be to help the humans should they need, and let their presence be disclosed.  
"And that is why, to this day, not all Pokémon do flee when a human they do see— they leap out where tall grasses sway."

locations.title: Old Verse 14
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"The fieldlands rush by underhoof as Wyrdeer carries me astride—  
"Companions of mine run with us and Pokémon dash alongside.  
"We come to stand where wind had swept and old days play before my eyes...  
"The memories come running through, linking this place to times gone by.  
"Time and space here blend together and enfold my heart as I remember."

locations.title: Old Verse 17
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**
"Once there was a god of field, and once there was a god of spring.  
"Upon Hisui's winds it wheeled, brought life to every growing thing.  
"'Where go you when you are not here?' asked I one day the god of spring.  
"No answer would it give me clear, but still did I have an inkling.  
"There is no great dark truth untold— it simply does not like the cold."

locations.title: Old Verse 15
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**
"The flow of time never stops... The past, future, and present...  
"Space is ever-expanding dimensions... Our spirits, too, are as space..."

locations.title: Old Verse 2
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"O you, who at the world's far-off end dwell, I know your wish—it is my wish as well.  
"My own beloved is now gone from me, departed to a place I cannot reach.  
"My old companions have left me behind, their faces faded into days gone by.  
"Still to my breast I clutch this hopeless dream, a futile wish for us once more to meet.  
"O you, who at the world's far-off end dwell, I know your wish—it is my wish as well.  
"But ours are cold and endless winter days, warmed only by memories locked away."

locations.title: Old Verse 13
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"Sootfoot, humble root— harvest it, and peel it.  
"Broiled, baked, or steamed will do, just let nobody steal it.  
"Mash the root, then knead the mash, then once more heat it over—  
"Grill it only till it browns— use Ember, not Flamethrower.  
"Now harken well, and listen closely: the wise adore potato mochi.  
"A day spent eating all in reach, is no day wasted, if you ask me."

locations.title: Old Verse 9
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"I set the bones of Pokémon adrift upon the river.  
"I let my memories flow on, adrift upon the river.  
"And to the ocean they will flow, perhaps around the world to go.  
"How many bones in days now gone have I now set adrift from me?  
"How many bones in days to come will I yet set adrift to sea?  
"While every gift with which I part takes a sliver of my heart."

locations.title: Old Verse 1
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"Once there were two. And one looked upon time's steady pace. And one looked upon the expanse of space.  
"And the two set out: the fullness of future did they seek, the world's far end would they greet.  
"Two different paths— each walking alone a path their own, though they walk with almighty Sinnoh."

locations.title: Old Verse 4
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"Ten Pokémon, the ancient hero's loyal retinue— though these companions now are gone, their noble duty passes on to generations new.  
"The people thank the ten descendants for their gen'rous toil by lining vessels built to last with water clear and choice repast before the arenas' soil."

locations.title: Old Verse 5
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"Long and longer yet ago, Celestica was here. But folk and town alike, both did disappear.  
"In time, came new folk sailing, sailing 'cross the sea, called by their love for Sinnoh, great and almighty.  
"But diff'rent were the Sinnoh that each folk did hold dear, And bitter strife and angry war were always at the near.  
"'Celestica' they called themselves, the name not theirs to take. Yet claim it from the past they did, for tragic quarrel's sake.  
"So once again did our name live, though all our people gone. But even if the name endures, its heart does not live on."

locations.title: Old Verse 10
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
“’Twas long ago he earned the name ’hero’...  
“He led his retinue, ten Pokémon, against the almighty unknowable.  
“In battle did his valiance proclaim at last the strength of humble humankind.  
“The great unknowable approved this feat, and to its domain of no place returned.”

locations.title: Old Verse 3
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"No claws nor fangs, no strength to claim— no man could hope to hold his own to mighty Pokémon.  
"But bolts of light rained down one day, ten times they fell, ten times struck true upon ten Pokémon.  
"Then to weak man did these ten turn, his strength to be, and all were blessed by loyal Pokémon.  
"Were not these bolts a gift to man? Were they not your almighty grace, great Sinnoh, paragon?"

locations.title: Old Verse 11
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
“’Let our wishes reach heaven’s crown,’ the people together vowed.  
“So they and their Pokémon bore stone to the peak of heaven’s mount.  
“The people carved the gathered stones in shapes of Pokémon—  
“the ten Pokémon that Sinnoh shone its almighty light upon.”

locations.title: Old Verse 16
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"Heaven's crown, nearest to almighty Sinnoh...  
"Power of almighty Sinnoh, gather as stone at heaven's mount.  
"Stone, let your power flow— distort and bend the world around you."

locations.title: Old Verse 8
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"Throughout Hisui, plates lie scattered— plates with powers all diverse.  
"Forever lasting, each inscribed with eternal prayer's verse.  
"Through space and time will they bear secret wishes for the universe."

locations.title: Old Verse 18
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"Offer only friendship to those around you.  
"Angering ??? in turn confounds you.  
"Sorrowing ??? will in woe drown you.  
"A land, once riven, cannot become new.  
"Let only peace and amity surround you."

locations.title: Old Verse 7
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Verse description:**  
"O, lake in alabaster lands of ice, lake brimming o'er with rich acuity...  
"How many seek the Pokémon that shows itself there, out to answer its words true and earn its boon through ingenuity?  
"But should they fail to understand its words and let its questions meet with no reply, their minds will be wiped clean of memory...  
"O, lake in alabaster lands of ice, depths where rich acuity goes to sink."

locations.title: Old Verse 12
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Location:** Underground, in Icepeak Cavern (access through [Icepeak Cavern entrance](#loc=161289)).  
**Verse description:**  
"Wintry... Austere... Brimming with strange power...  
"Certainly the land of Hisui bears some resemblance to Sinjoh.  
"Here, where the ancient Sinnoh people were born, I will spend an eternity... until the one with the mission appears."

locations.title: Old Verse 6
locations.description:
**How to get:** Use the Ursaluna mount.  
**Location:** In a passage under the mountain; access from the north or south.  
**Verse description:**  
"When that Pokémon was born, intelligence bloomed among us, enriching all our morrows.  
"When that Pokémon was born, emotions bloomed among us, giving us joy and sorrows.  
"When that Pokémon was born, willpower bloomed among us to act and not to wallow."

locations.title: #1: Wurmple can Evolve
locations.description:
*Beauregard of the Security Corps heard about Evolution from the professor, and now Beauregard wants to evolve a Wurmple of his own. You need to catch one for him.*  
**How to unlock:** Finish [Story Mission #3](#loc=156597).  
**How to start:** Speak with Beauregard  
**Objectives:**
- Catch a Wurmple to give to Beauregard

**Rewards:**
- 3x Dazzling Honey

locations.title: #2: Adorable Starly
locations.description:
*Show a Starly to Marli of the Supply Corps, who is rather taken with how adorable Starly are.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #3](#loc=156597).  
**How to start:** Speak with Marli.  
**Objectives:**
- Show Marli the completed Pokedex entry for Starly.
- Show Marli a Starly.

**Rewards:** 10x Poké Ball.

locations.title: #4: Big Buizel, Little Buizel
locations.description:
*Catch a big Buizel for Dorian of the Security Corps, who wants an even bigger specimen to raise alongside the Buizel he already has.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #3](#loc=156597).  
**How to start:** Speak with Dorian  
**Objectives:**
- Catch a big (2'8" and taller) Buizel to give to Dorian

**Rewards:**
- 5x Oran Berry
- 1x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #3: What Did Shinx's Ears Look Like?
locations.description:
*A villager named Toshi wants you to show him a Shinx, since he can't quite seem to remember what the marks on Shinx's ears look like.*  
**How to unlock:** After [Story Mission #3](#loc=156597).  
**How to start:** Speak with Toshi.  
**Objectives:**
- Catch a Shinx to show to Toshi.

**Rewards:**
- Potion x3

locations.title: #6: Mushroom Cake Marketing
locations.description:
*A villager named Morel wants everyone to know about the crafting recipe he invented using mushrooms. To that end, he says he'll teach the recipe to you!*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#5: A Request from Mai](#loc=156627).  
**How to start:** Speak with Morel  
**Objectives:**
- Give Morel the item he requested (Springy Mushroom)

**Rewards:**
- 1x Mushroom Cake Recipe
- 5x Cake-Lure Base

locations.title: #11: The Timbre of the Fields
locations.description:
*Music lover Yeo is captivated by the sound she hears coming from the Kricketot in the Obsidian Fieldlands. Fill in Kricketot's Pokédex page and show it to her!*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#5: A Request from Mai](#loc=156627).  
**How to start:** Speak with Yeo  
**Objectives:**
- Show Yeo the completed Pokédex entry for Kricketot.

**Rewards:** 1x Vivichoke

locations.title: #13: Trees That Bear Berries
locations.description:
*Bjorn of the Agriculture Corps wants you to get a Cheri Berry for him. He says he'll give you a helpful tip if you're able to grant his wish...*  
**How to unlock:** Start [Story Mission #5](#loc=156627).  
**How to start:** Speak with Bjorn.  
**Objectives:**
- Gather the number of Berries Bjorn wanted (3 Cheri Berries), then give them to him.

**Rewards:** 15x Poké Ball

locations.title: #8: Bothersome Bidoof
locations.description:
*It seems that some mischievous Bidoof have been causing quite a lot of trouble around the village lately. Get the details from Tsumugi of the Security Corps.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #5](#loc=156627).  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Tsumugi](#loc=157305) to learn more about her request.
- Add a Bidoof to your team, and go find the bothersome Bidoof troubling the village. They are located [here](#loc=157316), [here](#loc=157322) and [here](#loc=157325).

**Rewards:** 1x Rare Candy

locations.title: #7: Playing with Drifloon
locations.description:
*It appears that a Drifloon has been sighted playing with one of the village children. Go speak to Miki of the Security Corps for details.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#5: A Request from Mai](#loc=156627) and have Drifloon in the Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Miki](#loc=157317) to learn more about her request.
- Investigate the Drifloon playing with a child at [Prelude Beach](#loc=157320) in the evening.
- Report back to [Miki](#loc=157317) with your findings.

**Rewards:** 1x Stardust

locations.title: #9: Zubat's Eyes
locations.description:
*Clarissa of the Security Corps has a request, and it seems to have something to do with Zubat's eyes. Go hear what she has to say!*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #5](#loc=156627) and have Zubat in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Clarissa](#loc=157323) to learn more about her request.
- Catch a Zubat to show to Clarissa

**Rewards:** 2x Aux Power

locations.title: #12: A Perfect Pickling Stone
locations.description:
*A villager named Radisa is hoping a Geodude would be just the right weight to use as a pickling stone. Catch one for her to test out her theory.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#5: A Request from Mai](#loc=156627).  
**How to start:** Speak with Radisa (2nd floor).  
**Objectives:**
- Catch a Geodude to give to [Radisa](#loc=157332).

**Rewards:**
- 3x Honey Cake
- 1x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #18: Please! Make Me a Pokéshi Doll!
locations.description:
*Anvin from the craftworks has asked you to show him a Pokéshi Doll you've crafted with your own hands.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [Story Mission #7](#loc=157295).  
**How to start:** Speak with Anvin.  
**Objectives:**
- Craft a Pokéshi Doll (3x Wood), and show it to Anvin.

**Rewards:** 1x Pokéshi Doll

locations.title: #14: Berry Helpful
locations.description:
*A villager named Andra is terrified of Pokémon and wants you to find some Oran Berries for him, since they can come in handy when running from Pokémon.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#5: A Request from Mai](#loc=156627).  
**How to start:** Speak with Andra.  
**Objectives:**
- Gather the number of Berries Andra wanted (5x Oran Berry), then give them to him.

**Rewards:** 3x Revive

locations.title: #17: To Bloom or Not to Bloom
locations.description:
*Kichi of the Agriculture Corps wants an explanation for Cherrim's changeable appearance. He wants to see a completed Pokédex entry for Cherrim.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #5](#loc=156627).  
**How to start:** Speak with Kichi  
**Objectives:**
- Show Kicki the completed Pokédex entry for Cherrim

**Rewards:** 5x Vivichoke

locations.title: #15: Balloon Race in the Fieldsland
locations.description:
*The man running the balloon race in the Obsidian Fieldlands has issued you a challenge. You’ll get a special reward if you manage to burst 17 balloons.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #7](#loc=157295).  
**How to start:** Speak with the Balloon Race NPC.  
**Objectives:**
- Burst 17 balloons within the time limit for the balloon race in the Obsidian Fieldslands.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Rare Candy
- 15x Feather Ball

locations.title: #51: Coming Up Roses
locations.description:
*On Ramanas Island, Hiemo asked you to bring him a Pokémon with a scythe on each arm.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #10](#loc=157746)  
**How to start:** Speak with Hiemo.  
**Objectives:**
- Find the Pokémon with a scythe on each arm (Scyther) and catch one to show to Hiemo on Ramanas Island.

**Rewards:** 1x Seed of Mastery

locations.title: #89: The Diamond's Clan's Treasure
locations.description:
*Adaman of the Diamond Clan has challenged you to a battle. Claim victory against him to find out more about the treasure he mentioned.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #19](#loc=157748).  
**How to start:** Speak with Adaman  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with Adaman near the Diamond Settlement, and defeat him in battle.
- Adaman's team: Leafeon (LV64), Umbreon (LV32), Vaporeon (LV32)

**Rewards:**
- 3x Comet Shard
- 1x Adamant Crystal

locations.title: #32: The Headache-Stricken Psyduck
locations.description:
*Description*  
**How to unlock:** Enter [Diamond Settlement](#loc=156556).  
**How to start:** Speak with Martia.  
**Objectives:**
- Gather information in Jubilife Village about medicine that might ease the headaches of suffering Psyduck. (Speak with [Tomma](#loc=157750))
- Deliver the secret medicine to Martia.

**Rewards:** 1x Max Revive

locations.title: #30: A Beautiful Rose...
locations.description:
*Berra, a villager, has been utterly captivated by Roselia’s elegance and wishes to learn more about this Pokémon. Complete Roselia’s Pokédex page, and show it to Berra!*  
**How to unlock:** Visit the Crimson Mirelands  
**How to start:** Speak with Berra  
**Objectives:**
- Show Berra the completed Pokédex entry for Roselia.

**Rewards:**
- 5x Grain Cake
- 2x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #40: The Charm Lost in the Swamp
locations.description:
*Yojiro wants you to find his charm that he lost while being chased by an alpha Hippowdon.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #8](#loc=157753)  
**How to start:** Speak with Yojiro  
**Objectives:**
- Find the [charm](#loc=157754) that Yojiro dropped in the Crimson Mirelands.
- Chase away the Hippowdon and retrieve Yojiro’s charm.

**Rewards:**
- 5x Iron Chunk
- 1x Grit Gravel

locations.title: #31: Setting Up the Bogbound Camp
locations.description:
*It seems the Construction Corps could use some help setting up the new Bogbound Camp. A villager named Odo is worried about a Sudowoodo that seems to be under the weather. He wants your advice on what to do*  
**How to unlock:** Enter the Crimson Mirelands  
**How to start:** Speak with Odo  
**Objectives:**
- Go to help set up the[ Bogbound Camp](#loc=156549).
- Chase away the [three Stunky](#loc=157756).

**Rewards:** Unlocks the Bogbound Camp settlement.

locations.title: #49: Keep an Eye Out for Aipom!
locations.description:
*Hiko from the village had his pack stolen by some Aipom. He wants you to chase down the Aipom and get his pack back.*  
**How to unlock:** Visit the Cobalt Coastlands    
**How to start:** Speak with Hiko  
**Objectives:**
- Chase down the Aipom that stole Hiko’s pack.
    - They will pause [here](#loc=157758) and [here](#loc=159624), before stopping [here](#loc=159625).
- Defeat the Aipom, and retrieve the pack.

**Rewards:**
- 5x Scatter Bang
- 1x Exp. Candy M

locations.title: #56: Getting Help from Machoke
locations.description:
*Bosley wants to know more about Machoke so he can have it help with the Construction Corps’ work. Show him Machoke’s Pokédex page after it’s completed.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Story Mission #10](#loc=157746).  
**How to start:** Speak with Bosley  
**Objectives:**
- Show Bosley the completed Pokédex entry for Machoke.
- Wait for Bosley to invite Machoke to help the Construction Corps.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Grit Gravel
- 1x Aux Powerguard

locations.title: #47: Balloon Race in the Coastlands
locations.description:
*The man running the balloon race in the Cobalt Coastlands has issued you a challenge. You’ll get a special reward if you manage to burst 24 balloons.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Request #46](#loc=157761).  
**How to start:** Speak with the Balloon Race NPC.  
**Objectives:**
- Burst 24 balloons within the time limit for the balloon race in the Cobalt Coastlands.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Nugget
- 10x Ultra Ball

locations.title: #46: Setting Up the Coastlands Camp
locations.description:
*Gully of the Supply Corps wants you to find the missing Yorrich and tell him to return to where she’s waiting. He doesn’t seem to have gone to Deadwood Haunt...*  
**How to unlock:** Visit the Cobalt Coastlands  
**How to start:** Speak with Gully  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Gully](#loc=156573) to learn more about her request.
- Look for [Yorrich](#loc=157762) of the Construction Corps.
- Drive away the Chatot scaring Yorrich (must be done in nighttime).
- Report back to Gully with your progress.

**Rewards:** Unlocks the [Coastlands Camp](#loc=156573).

locations.title: #55: Poor, Peckish Piplup
locations.description:
*Maris of the Supply Corps wants to help a Piplup that’s too famished to move. She’s asked you to help her out by providing a tasty Bean Cake.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [Request #46](#loc=157761).  
**How to start:** Speak with Maris.  
**Objectives:**
- Give Maris the item she requested (1x Bean Cake).
- Bean Cakes can be crafted for 1x Plump Beans and 1x Cake-Lure Base. The recipe can be bought at [Craftworks](#loc=156483) for ₽1,000.

**Rewards:**
- 5x Razz Berry
- 3x Hyper Potion

locations.title: #87: Rolling with Spheal
locations.description:
*A villager named Senki has asked you to look for his Spheal that went rolling off into Bolderoll Ravine.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#17: Atop Mount Coronet](#loc=157780).  
**How to start:** Speak with Senki.  
**Objectives:**
- Find Senki’s Spheal, which has rolled off toward Bolderoll Ravine.
    - The Spheal will briefly stop [here](#loc=157978), [here](#loc=157979) and [here](#loc=157980). He will stop [here](#loc=157981).
- Return to the Summit Camp to speak with Senki.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Rare Candy
- 5x Sticky Glob

locations.title: #22: Eerie Apparitions at Night
locations.description:
*Collect the 107 wisps scattered around the Hisui region to seal away the “being who brought calamities” that the young girl in the village told you of.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#7: The Frenzy of the Lord of the Woods](#loc=157295)  
**How to start:** Automatic  
**Objectives:**
- Gather the wisps found scattered in every corner of the Hisui region (see the Wisp collectibles on the map).
- Go to the [Shrouded Ruins](#loc=157769) in the Crimson Mirelands at night.
- Receive the last wisp.

**Rewards:** 3x Twice-Spice Radish

locations.title: #91: On the Trail of Giratina
locations.description:
*A huge shadow has been seen in Cobalt Coastlands. According to Professor Laventon, there's a strong chance it is Giratina, the fearsome Pokemon you once battled.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#26: Seeking the Remaining Plates](#loc=157801).  
**How to start:** Speak with Professor Laventon.  
**Objectives:**
- Find out the truth behind the huge shadow in the Cobalt - Coastlands.
- Catch [Giratina](#loc=157807) before it wreaks havoc!
- Report back to Professor Laventon to share what you’ve learned.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Griseous Core
- 1x Grit Rock

locations.title: #5: What It Takes to Be Awesome
locations.description:
*A village boy named Sho is convinced you need a partner Pokémon to become an awesome member of the Galaxy Team. He wants some Poké Balls.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#5: A Request from Mai](#loc=156627).  
**How to start:** Speak with Sho.  
**Objectives:**
- Craft or buy some Poké Balls to give to Sho (5).

**Rewards:** 3x Grit Dust  
**Notes:** No marker will appear for this request initially; it appears after starting [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).

locations.title: #10: Wurmple's Evolved
locations.description:
*It seems Beauregard of the Security Corps has some questions about the Evolution of that Wurmple you gave him. Go find out more from him.*  
**How to unlock:**
- Complete [#5: A Request from Mai](#loc=156627).
- Evolve a Silcoon into a Beautifly
- Complete [#1: Wurmple can Evolve](#loc=156599).

**How to start:** Speak with Beauregard  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with Beauregard to learn more about his request.
- Catch a Silcoon or evolve a Wurmple into one, then show it to Beauregard.

**Rewards:** 1x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #16: Strange Happenings at Midnight
locations.description:
*Sanqua, the captain of the Construction Corps, says that strange things are happening in her house at night. She wants you to find out what is going on.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#7: The Frenzy of the Lord of the Woods](#loc=157295) and have Pichu in your Pokédex.    
**How to start:** Speak with Sanqua.  
**Objectives:**
- Search [Sanqua’s house](#loc=157812) to solve the mystery.
    - Investigate the chest by the entrance, both drawers, the drapped mirror and the round table. Then, investigate the chest again.

**Rewards:** 7x Nanab Berry

locations.title: #19: A Peculiar Ponyta
locations.description:
*Yota is alarmed by the unusual Ponyta that frequents the Horseshoe Plains. He wants you to catch it for him.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#7: The Frenzy of the Lord of the Woods](#loc=157295) and catch a Ponyta.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Yota](#loc=157814) to learn more about his request.
- Catch the strange Ponyta on the Horseshoe Plains in the Obsidian Fieldlands.
- Report back to Yota with your findings.

**Rewards:** 5x Razz Berry

locations.title: #20: The Mysterious Will-o'-the-Wisp
locations.description:
*A villager named Paira wants you to catch the will-o’-the-wisp she saw on Windswept Run to prove to Waka that she’s telling the truth.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#7: The Frenzy of the Lord of the Woods](#loc=157295).  
**How to start:** Speak with Paira.  
**Objectives:**
- Catch the [mysterious red will-o’-the-wisp](#loc=157816) on Windswept Run at night.
- Catch the Chimchar to show to Paira.

**Rewards:** 2x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #21: Back-Alley Mr. Mime
locations.description:
*That villager named Andra wants your help again, this time about a Mr. Mime that’s behaving suspiciously.*  
**How to unlock:**
- Complete [#7: The Frenzy of the Lord of the Woods](#loc=157295)
- Complete [#14: Berry Helpful](#loc=157307)
- Have Mr. Mime in your Pokédex
 
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Andra](#loc=157818) to learn more about his request.
- Find a way to approach Mr. Mime and see what it’s up to.
- Chase the fleeing Mr. Mime.

**Rewards:** 2x Aux Guard

locations.title: #23: Getting Ahold of New Wares
locations.description:
*Choy from the general store wants you to convince Tao Hua, captain of the Supply Corps, to sell him some new wares for his shop.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with Choy.  
**Objectives:**
- Try to sweeten up [Tao Hua](#loc=157820) with a gift (3x Hearty Grain) so he might sell new wares to the general store.
- Report back to Choy about your progress.

**Rewards:** New items added to the General Store (Heavy Ball, Feather Ball, Super Potion, Smoke Bomb, Mushroom Cake and Honey Cake).

locations.title: #24: Inspiration from Hippopotas
locations.description:
*The clothier Anthe has asked you to show her a male and a female Hippopotas since she heard that they each have different appearances.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with Anthe.  
**Objectives:**
- Catch a male and a female Hippopotas to show to Anthe.

**Rewards:** New items added to the Clothier.

locations.title: #25: The Pokémon in the Woodland Photo
locations.description:
*Dagero, who runs the photography studio, thinks a Pokémon that wandered into his photo would make an excellent subject. He wants you to catch one.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with Dagero.  
**Objectives:**
- Catch the Pokémon captured in Dagero’s photo (a Buneary) and show it to him.

**Rewards:** New options added to the photography studio.

locations.title: #26: Aim for the Big Leagues!
locations.description:
*The fellow running the target practice outside Jubilife Village has issued you a challenge. You’ll get a special reward if you manage to score 10,000 points or more.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with the Target Practice NPC.  
**Objectives:**
- Get a score of 10,000 points or more at the [target practice game](#loc=156466) hosted in the practice field outside Jubilife Village.

**Rewards:**
- 15x Great Ball
- 1x Nugget

locations.title: #27: Help Wanted: Plowing the Fields
locations.description:
*Miller from the Agriculture Corps says the ground is too hard to plow. He wants to borrow a Pokémon to help with plowing the land to prepare it for planting.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with Miller.  
**Objectives:**
- Lend a Ground-type Pokémon to Miller.

**Rewards:** More fields available for farming.

locations.title: #28: Measuring Your Compatibility
locations.description:
*A villager named Belamy says you remind him of his grandmother. He wants you to show him that you can likewise befriend Pokémon as she could.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with Belamy.  
**Objectives:**
- Show a Pokémon with which you have a strong enough bond to satisfy Belamy.
    - Pokémon with whom you have battled a lot should have high friendship.

**Rewards:** 1x Rare Candy

locations.title: #29: The Search for Bitter Leaves
locations.description:
*Shinon wants to make some medicine and asks you to collect the materials needed. Anise of the Medical Corps filled you in on what you need to find to make medicine. Seems you can find the materials in the Crimson Mirelands, but...*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with Shinon.  
**Objectives:**
- Ask [Anise](#loc=157827) about the materials that are needed for the medicine.
- Find the Pokémon with three leaves (Petilil) in the Crimson Mirelands and catch one to give to Anise.

**Rewards:**
- 3x Fine Remedy
- 5x Hopo Berry

locations.title: #33: What a Massive Mushroom!
locations.description:
*Go have a chat with Morel, a local fungus expert, and investigate the mushrooom on Parasect's back together.*  
**How to unlock:**
- Start [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753)
- Complete [#6: Mushroom Cake Marketing](#loc=156637)
- Have Parasect in your Pokédex

**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Morel](#loc=157829) to learn more about his request.
- Catch a Parasect to give to Morel.

**Rewards:** 1x Candy Truffle

locations.title: #34: Croagunk's Curative Poison
locations.description:
*It seems that Pesselle, captain of the Medical Corps, can make medicine using Croagunk’s poison. Ask her for more information so you can help her out.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#9: A New Mission](#loc=157770) and have Croagunk in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with Pesselle to learn more about her request.
- Catch a Croagunk to give to [Pesselle](#loc=157831).

**Rewards:**
- 3x Full Heal
- 3x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #35: Battling with Pachirisu
locations.description:
*Speak with Ren to learn more about his request.
Remove all other Pokémon from your party and show Ren a great strategy for battling with a Pachirisu.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753) and catch a Pachirisu.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Ren](#loc=157833) to learn more about his request.
- Remove all other Pokémon from your party and show Ren a great strategy for battling with a Pachirisu.
    - You must face an Ursaring LV30 with only Pachirisu in your party (you can have more than 1).

**Rewards:**
- 3x Sitrus Berry
- 1x Grit Gravel

locations.title: #36: Watering with Care
locations.description:
*You’ve been tasked with finding a Pokémon that can use Water Pulse to help perk up the Sudowoodo at the Bogbound Camp in the Crimson Mirelands.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#10: The Lordless Island](#loc=157746) and have Sudowoodo in your Pokédex.    
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Show a Pokémon that can use Water Pulse to [Odo](#loc=157835).
- Battle the agitated Sudowoodo and calm it down.

**Rewards:**
- 15x Heavy Ball
- 3x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #37: The Fragrence of Nostalgic Herbs
locations.description:
*A villager named Risa wants you to find a Pokémon that she remembers from back home. It’s covered in herbs shaped like blue vines.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with Risa (in the basement)  
**Objectives:**
- Find the Pokémon covered in herbs shaped like blue vines (Tangela) and catch one to show to Risa.

**Rewards:**
- 5x Smoke Bomb
- 2x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #38: Gone Astray...In The Mirelands
locations.description:
*A villager named Zeke wants you to find his sister, Wanda. She’s a member of the Security Corps, and she seems to have gone missing in the Crimson Mirelands.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753).  
**How to start:** Speak with Zeke.  
**Objectives:**
- Ride on Ursaluna and follow the blue signals to locate [Wanda](#loc=157838) in the Crimson Mirelands.
- Report back to Zeke on the first floor of [Galaxy Hall](#loc=156476).

**Rewards:** 3x Stardust

locations.title: #39: All about Magikarp
locations.description:
*A little girl in the village named Ceci has asked you to teach her more about Magikarp.*  
**How to unlock:** Have Magikarp in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Speak with Ceci during the day.  
**Objectives:**
- Show Ceci the completed Pokédex entry for Magikarp.

**Rewards:** 1x Rare Candu

locations.title: #41: An Elegant Tail
locations.description:
*A villager named Asabei saw the tail of a Pokémon hiding behind some rocks and was captivated by its elegant movements. He wants you to show him this Pokémon.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#9: A New Mission](#loc=157770)  
**How to start:** Speak with Asabei  
**Objectives:**
- Find the Pokémon with the elegant tail that curls like a spring (Glameow), and catch one to show to Asabei.

**Rewards:**
- 2x Aux Evasion
- 2x Grit Gravel

locations.title: #42: Help Wanted: Watering the Fields
locations.description:
*To expand the fields, more irrigation is needed. Lend a Pokémon that can help with the task to Miller from the Agriculture Corps.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#9: A New Mission](#loc=157770) and complete [#27: Help Wanted: Plowing the Fields](#loc=157824).  
**How to start:** Speak with Miller  
**Objectives:**
- Lend a Pokémon that can use a Water-type move to Miller.

**Rewards:** More fields available for farming.

locations.title: #43: More New Wares
locations.description:
*Choy from the general store wants you to convince Tao Hua, captain of the Supply Corps, to sell him some new wares for his shop.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#9: A New Mission](#loc=157770) and complete [#23: Getting Ahold of New Wares](#loc=157819).  
**How to start:** Speak with Choy  
**Objectives:**
- Try to sweeten up [Tao Hua](#loc=157820) with a gift (3x Pop Pods) so he might sell new wares to the general store.
- Report back to Choy about your progress.

**Rewards:** New items added to the General Store (Great Ball, Hyper Potion, Full Heal, Stealth Spray, Scatter Bang, Grain Cake).

locations.title: #44: The Pokémon in the Nighttime Photo
locations.description:
*Dagero from the photography studio captured another strange Pokémon in one of his photos. He wants you to identify it and catch one for him.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#9: A New Mission](#loc=157770) and complete [#25: The Pokémon in the Woodland Photo](#loc=157822).  
**How to start:** Speak with Dagero  
**Objectives:**
- Catch the Pokémon captured in Dagero’s photo (Duskull) and show it to him.

**Rewards:** New options added at the photography studio.

locations.title: #45: Shellos of the East and West
locations.description:
*Shellos can look different depending on where they live, and the clothier Anthe thinks seeing that will inspire her. Show her two Shellos with different appearances.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#9: A New Mission](#loc=157770) and complete [#24: Inspiration from Hippopotas](#loc=157821).  
**How to start:** Speak with Anthe.  
**Objectives:**
- Catch an East Sea Shellos and a West Sea Shellos to show to Anthe.

**Rewards:** New items added to the Clothier.

locations.title: #48: The Taste of Home
locations.description:
*Floaro of the Construction Corps is thinking of cooking a treat from his homeland to try to win over an Eevee, and he has asked you to gather some ingredients.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#9: A New Mission](#loc=157770).  
**How to start:** Speak with Floaro.  
**Objectives:**
- Gather the necessary materials for Floaro (3x Hearty Grain, 2x Hopo Berry, 1x Razz Berry).  

**Rewards:** 5x Exp. Candy S

locations.title: #50: Double the Tails, Double the Fun
locations.description:
*Netta of the Security Corps says she spotted a Pokémon with two tail fins and would like to see it once more. Try to catch one, and show it to her.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#10: The Lordless Island](#loc=157746).  
**How to start:** Speak with Netta.  
**Objectives:**
- Find the Pokémon with two tail fins (Finneonn) and catch one to show to Netta.

**Rewards:** 1x Star Piece

locations.title: #52: Eevee's Evolutions
locations.description:
*Floaro of the Construction Corps wants to discuss Eevee’s evolution. You should go and have a chat with him.*  
**How to unlock:**
- Complete [#10: The Lordless Island](#loc=157746)
- Complete [#48: The Taste of Home](#loc=157845)
- Have Eevee in your Pokédex

**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Floaro](#loc=157849) to learn more about his request.
- Search for the missing [Eevee](#loc=157850).
- Feed the hungry Umbreon a muffin (2x Hearty Grains, 2x Hopo Berry, 1x Razz Berry, 1x Cake-Lure Base).

**Rewards:** 1x Rare Candy

locations.title: #53: Octillery's Ink
locations.description:
*Radisa from the village sees culinary potential in Octillery ink, and she wants to try using it to make a new dish. Complete Octillery’s Pokédex page, and show it to her.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#10: The Lordless Island](#loc=157746).  
**How to start:** Speak with Radisa  
**Objectives:**
- Show Radisa the completed Pokédex entry for Octillery.

**Rewards:**
- 5x Bean Cake
- 1x Exp. Candy M

locations.title: #54: Serving Up Swap Snacks
locations.description:
*Bonn from the candy stand has decided to teach you a recipe of his that was shelved due to complaints from his customers.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#10: The Lordless Island](#loc=157746) and speak to Bonn at least once before.  
**How to start:** Speak with Bonn.  
**Objectives:**
- Gather the necessary materials for Bonn (1x Sootfoot Root, 1x Spring Mushroom, 1x Hopo Berry).

**Rewards:** 1x Swap Snack

locations.title: #57: The Taste of Honey
locations.description:
*Almous of the Agriculture Corps has a request for you regarding the flavor of honey produced by Combee. Go speak to him, and see what you need to do.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#10: The Lordless Island](#loc=157746) and have Combee in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Speak with Almous.  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Almous](#loc=157854) to learn more about his request.
- Catch a Combee in [Grueling Grove](#loc=156976), then show it to Almous.
- Catch a Combee on [Aipom Hill](#loc=157007), then show it to Almous.
- Catch a Combee on [Ramanas Island](#loc=156981), then show it to Almous.

**Rewards:**
- 3x Dazzling Honey
- 3x King's Leaf

locations.title: #58: Gone Astray...in the Coastlands
locations.description:
*Zeke from the village wants you to find his sister, Wanda, once again. She seems to have gone missing in the Cobalt Coastlands this time.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#10: The Lordless Island](#loc=157746) and [#38: Gone Astray...In The Mirelands](#loc=157837).  
**How to start:** Speak with Zeke.  
**Objectives:**
- Ride on Ursaluna and follow the blue signals to locate [Wanda](#loc=157856) in the Cobalt Coastlands.
- Report back to Zeke on the first floor of [Galaxy Hall](#loc=156476).

**Rewards:** 1x Star Piece

locations.title: #59: Misdreavus the Hairstyle Muse
locations.description:
*Arezu thinks she might take inspiration from a good look at a Misdreavus. She wants you to show her one so she can create some new hairstyles.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771).  
**How to start:** Speak with Arezu.  
**Objectives:**
- Catch the Pokémon needed to inspire Arezu (Misdreavus).

**Rewards:** New styles added to the Hairdresser.

locations.title: #60: Help Wanted: Rock Smashing in the Fields
locations.description:
*Miller from the Agriculture Corps wants to expand the fields even more, but a giant boulder is in the way! Lend him a Pokémon that can smash up the boulder.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771) and complete [#42: Help Wanted: Watering the Fields](#loc=157841).  
**How to start:** Speak with Miller.  
**Objectives:**
- Lend a Pokémon that can use Rock Smash to Miller.

**Rewards:** More fields available for farming.

locations.title: #61: Even More Wares
locations.description:
*Choy from the general store wants you to convince Tao Hua, captain of the Supply Corps, to sell him some new wares for his shop.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771) and complete [#43: More New Wares](#loc=157842).  
**How to start:** Speak with Choy.  
**Objectives:**
- Try to sweeten up [Tao Hua](#loc=157820) with a gift (3x Crunchy Salt) so he might sell new wares to the general store.
- Report back to Choy about your progress.

**Rewards:** New items added to the General Store (Leaden Ball, Wing Ball, Max Potion, Bean Cake).

locations.title: #62: The Pokémon in the River Photo
locations.description:
*Dagero from the photography studio suspects that the pair of leaves in one of his landscape photos is actually a Pokémon and wants you to confirm this for him.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771) and complete [#44: The Pokémon in the Nighttime Photo](#loc=157843).  
**How to start:** Speak with Dagero  
**Objectives:**
- Catch the Pokémon captured in Dagero’s photo (Turtwig) and show it to him.

**Rewards:** New options added at the photography studio.

locations.title: #63: Fancy, Fashionnable Wormadam
locations.description:
*The clothier Anthe wants you to show her a Wormadam, hoping the sight will inspire her to come up with some new clothing designs.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771) and complete [#45: Shellos of the East and West](#loc=157844).  
**How to start:** Speak with Anthe.  
**Objectives:**
- Catch a Wormadam to show to Anthe.

**Rewards:** New items added to the Clothier.

locations.title: #64: Getting to Know the Ghosts
locations.description:
*A villager named Ward claims his son Conlan is afraid of ghosts. To help him overcome his fear, Ward has asked you to show him Gastly’s completed Pokédex page.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771) and have Gastly in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Speak with Ward.  
**Objectives:**
- Show Ward the completed Pokédex entry for Gastly.

**Rewards:** 1x Linking Cord

locations.title: #65: Setting Up the Mountain Camp
locations.description:
*A Bronzor is getting in the way of a new base camp’s construction and seems to want to tell you something. Eshim has asked you to investigate.*  
**How to unlock:** Visit the Coronet Highlands  
**How to start:** Talk to Eshim  
**Objectives:**
- Find out [what Bronzor wants](#loc=157864).

**Rewards:** A new base camp.

locations.title: #66: The Sea's Legend
locations.description:
*The Pokémon that Professor Laventon saw in the ocean might be connected to the Pokémon that appears in “The Sea’s Legend”...*  
**How to unlock:**
- Start [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771)
- Have Buizel, Mantyke and Qwilfish in your Pokédex
- Reach Star Rank 5

**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Solve the mystery of “The Sea’s Legend,” and catch [the Pokémon](#loc=157867) that Professor Laventon saw.
    - Go through the stone pillars [here](#loc=157868), in the evening, with an Overqwil, a Buizel and a Mantyke to solve the mystery.
- Report back to Professor Laventon to share what you’ve learned about Manaphy.

**Rewards:** 3x Comet Shard

locations.title: #67: The Clefairy's Moonlit Dance
locations.description:
*Astair of the Supply Corps says that Clefairy dance on nights with a full moon where he comes from. Investigate whether they dance here in Hisui.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771) and have Clefairy in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Astair](#loc=157870) to learn more about his request.
- Investigate whether Clefairy dance in the [Fabled Spring](#loc=157871) on nights with a full moon.
- Report back to Astair with your findings.

**Rewards:**
- 5x Salt Cake
- 1x Moon Stone
- 2x Exp. Candy M

locations.title: #68: A Nosepass to Guide the Way
locations.description:
*There’s an old saying that “A Nosepass never wanders.” Gully of the Supply Corps therefore asks for a Nosepass to keep her from getting lost in Wayward Cave.*  
**How to unlock:**
- Complete [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771)
- Complete [#46: Setting Up the Coastlands Camp](#loc=157761)
- Have Nosepass in your Pokédex

**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282)  
**Objectives:**
- Talk to [Gully](#loc=157873) to learn more about his request
- Catch a Nosepass to give to Gully.
- Report back to [Gully](#loc=157874).

**Rewards:**
- 1x Black Augurite
- 2x Exp. Candy M

locations.title: #69: Gone Astray...in the Highlands
locations.description:
*Zeke from the village wants you to find his sister, Wanda, once again. She seems to have gone missing in the Coronet Highlands this time.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771) and [#58: Gone Astray...in the Coastlands](#loc=157855).  
**How to start:** Speak with Zeke.  
**Objectives:**
- Ride on Ursaluna and follow the blue signals to locate [Wanda](#loc=157876) in the Coronet Highlands.
- Report back to Zeke on the first floor of [Galaxy Hall](#loc=156476).

**Rewards:** 2x Star Piece

locations.title: #70: Colorful New Looks
locations.description:
*The clothier Anthe wants to create clothes in new colors and has sent you in search of the materials she needs to do so.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and complete [#63: Fancy, Fashionnable Wormadam](#loc=157861).  
**How to start:** Speak with Anthe.  
**Objectives:**
- Gather the necessary materials for Anthe (1x Green Shard, 1x Red Shard, 1x Blue Shard)

**Rewards:** New items added to the Clothier.

locations.title: #71: New Wares Yet Again
locations.description:
*Choy from the general store wants you to convince Tao Hua, captain of the Supply Corps, to sell him some new wares for his shop.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and complete [#61: Even More Wares](#loc=157859).  
**How to start:** Speak with Choy.  
**Objectives:**
- Try to sweeten up [Tao Hua](#loc=157820) with a gift (3x Sand Radishes), so he might sell new wares to the general store.
- Report back to Choy about your progress.

**Rewards:** New items added to the General Store (Ultra Ball, Full Restore, Max Revive, Sticky Glob, Salt Cake).

locations.title: #72: Pesselle's Easy Errand
locations.description:
*Pesselle of the Medical Corps has asked you to bring her a hundred Medicinal Leeks.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and complete [#34: Croagunk's Curative Poison](#loc=157830).  
**How to start:** Speak with Pesselle  
**Objectives:**
- Gather the necessary materials (100x Medicinal Leek) for Pesselle.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Adamant Mint
- 1x Modest Mint

locations.title: #73: Which is the Real Burmy?
locations.description:
*Leif, Duna, and Tarush in the village can’t agree on which form of Burmy is the real one. Each of them has asked you to show them a different Burmy.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772).  
**How to start:** Speak with Leif  
**Objectives:**
- Catch a Burmy to show to Leif, Duna, and Tarush.
- Show Leif, Duna, and Tarush the completed Pokédex entry for Burmy.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Leaf Stone
- 3x Exp. Candy M

locations.title: #74: A Bit of Help from Blissey
locations.description:
*It seems [Pippa](#loc=157948) of the Supply Corps has a request concerning Blissey, a Pokémon that once came to her aid.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and have Blissey in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with Pippa in the Alabaster Icelands to learn more about her request.
- Meet up with Pippa.
- Battle the angry Abomasnow to calm it down.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Shiny Stone
- 1x Max Revive

locations.title: #75: Kirlia the Hairstyle Muse
locations.description:
*Arezu thinks she might take inspiration from a good look at a Kirlia. She wants you to show her one so she can create some new hairstyles.*  
**How to unlock:**  Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and complete [#59: Misdreavus the Hairstyle Muse](#loc=157857).  
**How to start:** Speak with Arezu.  
**Objectives:**
- Catch the Pokémon needed to inspire Arezu (Kirlia).

**Rewards:** New styles added to the Hairdresser.

locations.title: #76: Mushroom Hunting with Swinub
locations.description:
*Morel from the village is at Heart’s Crag in the Alabaster Icelands, and he seems to have a request for you concerning a special skill of Swinub’s.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and complete [#33: What a Massive Mushroom!](#loc=157828).  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Morel](#loc=157951) at Heart’s Crag in the Alabaster Icelands to hear his request.
- Add a Swinub to your party, and hunt for mushrooms buried in the snow.
- Report back to Morel with your results.

**Rewards:**
- 5x Sand Radish
- 1x Exp. Candy L

locations.title: #77: Gone Astray...in the Fieldlands
locations.description:
*Zeke from the village wants you to find his sister, Wanda, yet again. This time she has somehow gotten lost in the Obsidian Fieldlands right outside the village.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and complete [#69: Gone Astray...in the Highlands](#loc=157875).  
**How to start:** Speak with Zeke  
**Objectives:**
- Ride on Ursaluna and follow the blue signals to locate [Wanda](#loc=157953) in the Obsidian Fieldlands.
- Defeat the three Paras attacking Wanda.
- Report back to Zeke on the first floor of [Galaxy Hall](#loc=156476).

**Rewards:** 3x Star Piece

locations.title: #78: Setting Up the Icepeak Camp
locations.description:
*Brice of the Supply Corps wants you to find Craig. They were to meet at the base of the falls in the Alabaster Icelands, yet he hasn’t shown...*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772).  
**How to start:** Speak with Brice  
**Objectives:**
- Look for [Craig](#loc=157955) of the Construction Corps.
- Report back to Brice with your findings.

**Rewards:** A new base camp.

locations.title: #79: Balloon Race in the Icelands
locations.description:
*The man running the balloon race in the Alabaster Icelands has issued you a challenge. You’ll get a special reward if you manage to burst 30 balloons.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and [#78: Setting Up the Icepeak Camp](#loc=157954).  
**How to start:** Speak with the Balloon Race NPC.  
**Objectives:**
- Burst 30 balloons within the time limit for the balloon race in the Alabaster Icelands.

**Rewards:** 3x Nugget

locations.title: #80: The Perfect Pickle Recipe
locations.description:
*Radisa from the village believes she’s come up with the perfect pickle recipe and has asked you to gather the ingredients before she’ll teach it to you.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and complete [#53: Octillery's Ink](#loc=157851).  
**How to start:** Speak with Radisa.  
**Objectives:**
- Gather the necessary materials for Radisa (2x Crunchy Salt, 2x Plump Beans, 2x King's Leaf).

**Rewards:** 1x Twice-Spice Radish

locations.title: #81: In Search of a Fiery Pokémon
locations.description:
*Brice of the Supply Corps is working at the chilly Icepeak Camp and wants a Fire-type Pokémon.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#78: Setting Up the Icepeak Camp](#loc=157954).  
**How to start:** Speak with Brice  
**Objectives:**
- Catch a Fire-type Pokémon to give to Brice.

**Rewards:**
- 3x Full Restore
- 1x Exp. Candy L

locations.title: #82: Traces of a Lost Village
locations.description:
*Mani from the Ginkgo Guild says his ancestors may have once lived at the Avalanche Slopes in the Alabaster Icelands. See if you can find traces of a village there.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772).  
**How to start:** Speak with Mani (in the Basement)  
**Objectives:**
- Search for traces of a village said to have been located at the Avalanche Slopes in the Alabaster Icelands.
    - You will find them [here](#loc=157960), then [here](#loc=157961).
- Give the Old Journal to Mani.

**Rewards:** 1x Dawn Stone

locations.title: #83: Snow-White Vulpix in the Snow
locations.description:
*Keaka, a Security Corps member from the Alola region, has some peculiar Vulpix that he calls Keokeo. Go ask him about them so you can help with his request.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and have Vulpix in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Keaka](#loc=157963) to learn more about his request.
- Find the Alolan Vulpix hiding out in the Alabaster Icelands.
    - There are five Alolan Vulpix: [#1](#loc=157964), [#2](#loc=157965), [#3](#loc=157966), [#4](#loc=157967), [#5](#loc=157968)
- Report back to Keaka with your progress.

**Rewards:** 1x Exp. Candy L

locations.title: #84: The Bergmite Enthusiast
locations.description:
*Dominia from the Pearl Clan is a big fan of Bergmite and has asked you to show her Bergmite’s completed Pokédex page so she can verify its information.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772).  
**How to start:** Speak with Dominia.  
**Objectives:**
- Show Dominia the completed Pokédex entry for Bergmite.

**Rewards:** Grit Pebble x3

locations.title: #85: At Home under the Eaves
locations.description:
*It seems that a wild Chimecho has made itself at home under the eaves of one of the village houses. Talk to a villager named Ida to find out more.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and have Chimecho in your Pokédex.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with [Ida](#loc=157971) outside one of the village residences to learn more about her request.
- Find a place that Chimecho could hang from at [the farmhouse near the fields](#loc=157972).
- Report back to Ida with your findings.
- Find a place that Chimecho could hang from at [the hut on the beach](#loc=157973).
- Report back to Ida with your findings.
- Find a place that Chimecho could hang from in [the training grounds](#loc=157974).
- Report back to Ida with your findings.
- Find a place that Chimecho could hang from at [the house next door](#loc=157975) to Ida’s home.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Rare Candy
- 1x Sun Stone

locations.title: #86: Gone Astray...in the Icelands
locations.description:
*Wanda of the Security Corps wants you to find her brother, the villager Zeke, who went looking for her in the Alabaster Icelands.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772) and [#77: Gone Astray...in the Fieldlands](#loc=157952).  
**How to start:** Speak with Wanda  
**Objectives:**
- Ride on Ursaluna and follow the blue signals to locate [Zeke](#loc=157977) in the Alabaster Icelands.
- Defeat the Glalie, and save Zeke.

**Rewards:**
- 1x Ice Stone
- 1x Peat Block
- 5x Star Piece

locations.title: #88: Steely Lucario
locations.description:
*Rye from the village wants you to battle with him and his partner, Lucario.*  
**How to unlock:** Start [#17: Atop Mount Coronet](#loc=157780).  
**How to start:** Speak with Lucario.  
**Objectives:**
- Battle Lucario at the [training grounds](#loc=156481).

**Rewards:** 1x Grit Rock

locations.title: #90: The Pearl's Clan Treasure
locations.description:
*Irida of the Pearl Clan has challenged you to a battle. Claim victory against her to find out more about the treasure she mentioned.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#19: A New Day Dawns](#loc=157748).  
**How to start:** Speak with Irida.  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with Irida near the Pearl Settlement, and defeat her in battle.
    - Irida's team: Glaceon (LV64), Flareon (LV32), Espeon (LV32)

**Rewards:**
- 3x Comet Shard
- 1x Lustrous Globe

locations.title: #92: A Token of Gratitude
locations.description:
*Help Medi of the Diamond Clan find the rare Pokémon she met long ago, and survey the Pokémon while you’re at it.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#18: The Counterpart](#loc=157784) and have a save file from Pokémon Sword or Shield.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Talk to [Medi](#loc=157985) to learn more about her request.
- Find the field of Gracidea flowers located somewhere in the Obsidian Fieldlands.
- Catch [Shaymin](#loc=157986) in the field of Gracidea flowers.

**Rewards:** 1x Grit Rock

locations.title: #93: The Darksome Nightmare
locations.description:
*Get more details from Cael of the Pearl Clan about the terrifying Pokémon he saw and find out its location so you can survey it.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#18: The Counterpart](#loc=157784) and have a save file from Pokémon Brilliant Diamond or Shining Pearl.  
**How to start:** Interact with the [Blackboard](#loc=157282).  
**Objectives:**
- Speak with Cael to learn more about his request.
- Search for the mysterious black Pokémon that appears around the Clamberclaw Cliffs at night.
- Catch [Darkrai](#loc=157988) around the Clamberclaw Cliffs.

**Rewards:** 1x Exp. Candy XL

locations.title: #94: Incarnate Forces of Hisui
locations.description:
*Legend has it that Hisui is home to a group of Pokémon said to be forces of nature incarnate. Investigate them to bring your Pokédex closer to completion.*  
**How to unlock:** Complete [#18: The Counterpart](#loc=157784).  
**How to start:** Enter the [Galaxy Hall](#loc=156476).  
**Objectives:**
- Show Cogita the completed Pokédex entries for [Tornadus](#loc=157990), [Thundurus](#loc=157992), and [Landorus](#loc=157991).
- Show Cogita the completed Pokédex entry for [Enamorus](#loc=157993).

**Rewards:** 1x Exp. Candy L

locations.title: #1: In an Unfamiliar Land
locations.description:
*Professor Laventon has brought you to Jubilife Village, an unfamiliar settlement bustling with unfamiliar faces. How will you find your footing in this strange land?*  
**Steps:**
1. Head to [The Wallflower](#loc=156595), which serves as the village canteen.
2. Head to the [Survey Corps quarters](#loc=156475) you’ve been assigned.
3. Sleep until morning in the futon in [your quarters](#loc=156475).
4. Go to the [Galaxy Team headquarters](#loc=156476) to hear about your trial from Captain Cyllene.

**Next mission:** [#2: The Galaxy Team's Entry Trial](#loc=156596)

locations.title: #2: The Galaxy Team's Entry Trial
locations.description:
*You’ve been set a trial you must clear to join the Galaxy Team. If you want to stay in the village, catch yourself a Bidoof, a Starly, and a Shinx in the Obsidian Fieldlands.*  
**Steps:**
1. Choose a Pokémon to be your first partner in preparation for your trial.
2. Depart for the Obsidian Fieldlands from [Jubilife Village’s front gate](#loc=156472).
3. Catch a Bidoof, the first Pokémon species you need for your  trial.
4. Catch a Starly, the second Pokémon species you need for your trial.
5. Catch a Shinx, the third Pokémon species you need for your trial.
6. Report to [Captain Cyllene](#loc=156476) about how your trial went.
7. Use the mirror in [your quarters](#loc=156475) to change into your new Survey Corps uniform and Survey Corps sandals.
8. Report to Commander Kamado in his office on the third floor of [Galaxy Hall](#loc=156476).

**Next mission:** [#3: The Basics of Crafting](#loc=156597)

locations.title: #3: The Basics of Crafting
locations.description:
*You’ve cleared your trial and joined the Survey Corps. Now it’s time to acquire the skills you’ll need as a recruit. Learn about crafting items to use on your missions.*  
**Steps:**
1. Visit the [craftworks](#loc=156483) to learn how to craft items.
2. Use the [workbench](#loc=156483) to make one or more Poké Balls.

**Next mission:** [#4: Getting to Work on Research Tasks](#loc=156598)

locations.title: #4: Getting to Work on Research Tasks
locations.description:
*In order to complete the Pokédex, you’ll need to accomplish research tasks set by Professor Laventon. Speak to the professor to learn more.*  
**Steps:**
1. Head to the [Obsidian Fieldlands](#loc=156472) and speak to [Professor Laventon](#loc=156512) about research tasks.
2. Follow Akari/Rei to learn some tips for carrying out research tasks.
3. Report your research tasks to [Professor Laventon](#loc=156512) and earn a sufficient number of Pokémon research points (500).
4. Let [Captain Cyllene](#loc=156476) know that you’ve earned enough Pokémon research points to move up to the next rank.

**Next mission:** [#5: A Request from Mai](#loc=156627)

locations.title: #5: A Request from Mai
locations.description:
*It seems the Galaxy Team has gotten a request from Mai of the Diamond Clan. Go hear more about it and lend her your help as a member of the Survey Corps.*  
**Steps:**
1. Meet Akari/Rei at the [training grounds](#loc=156482).
2. Have a battle with Akari/Rei before you start your work for the day.
3. Go to the [Obsidian Fieldlands](#loc=156628) to meet Mai of the Diamond Clan.
4. Defeat Mai in battle to prove your strength to her.
5. Make your way to [Deertrack Heights](#loc=156629), where an alpha Pokémon is causing trouble.
6. Battle the alpha Pokémon causing trouble upon Deertrack Heights.

**Next mission:** [#6: Summoned by Commander Kamado](#loc=157276)

locations.title: #6: Summoned by Commander Kamado
locations.description:
*Commander Kamado has summoned you, and it seems urgent. Go find out what the commander needs.*  
**Steps:**
1. Report to the commander’s office in [Galaxy Hall](#loc=156476).

**Next mission:** [#7: The Frenzy of the Lord of the Woods](#loc=157295)

locations.title: #7: The Frenzy of the Lord of the Woods
locations.description:
*Kleavor, the Lord of the Woods, seems to have been driven into a frenzy by a strange lightning strike. You must search for a way to quell his frenzy.*  
**How to start:** Automatic  
**Steps:**
1. Report to your captain in [her office](#loc=156476) to learn more about your next mission.
2. Find your way to [Grandtree Arena](#loc=156497) to speak with Lian and get information on Kleavor.
3. Head to a [base camp](#loc=156504) and report what you’ve learned to Professor Laventon.
4. Return to [Galaxy Hall](#loc=156476) and join the professor in his research lab to formulate a strategy.
5. Work with Lian and Irida to make “Teatime Balls” from Kleavor’s favorite foods.
6. Prove yourself to [Irida](#loc=156498) by defeating her in battle.
7. Quell the frenzy of [Kleavor](#loc=157178), Lord of the Woods, at Grandtree Arena.
8. Report to [Commander Kamado](#loc=156476) that you have accomplished your mission.

**Next mission:** [#8: Arezu's Predicament](#loc=157753)

locations.title: #10: The Lordless Island
locations.description:
*Curious rumors have been pouring in from the Cobalt Coastlands, an area without a noble Pokémon. You must find out what’s behind these strange happenings.*  
**Steps:**
1. Head to the Cobalt Coastlands and speak with [Irida](#loc=159596) there.
2. Head to Veilstone Cape to speak with [Palina](#loc=159597) of the Pearl Clan.
3. Find the home of [Iscan](#loc=159642), a Diamond Clan warden, on Aipom Hill.
4. Obtain a Dusclops, which can be found around [Deadwood Haunt](#loc=156569) during the night, and take it with you to Iscan’s home.
5. Go to [Ginkgo Landing](#loc=156567) to call Basculegion.
6. Ride on Basculegion to follow the bandits across the water to Firespit Island.
7. Take back the Growlithe that the Miss Fortune sisters stole.
8. Quell the frenzy of [Arcanine](#loc=157180), the Lord of the Isles, at Molten Arena.
9. Report to [Commander Kamado](#loc=156476) that you have accomplished your mission.

**Next mission:** [#11: Scaling Perilious Heights](#loc=157771)

locations.title: #19: A New Day Dawns
locations.description:
*The rift in space-time has disappeared, and calamity seems to have been averted. At last you can return to the Survey Corps’ main duty: completing the Pokédex.*  
**Steps:**
- Leave [your quarters](#loc=156475).
- Head to the [Survey Corps office](#loc=156476) to discuss what to do next.

**Next mission:**
- [#20: The Researcher of Myths](#loc=157788)

locations.title: #8: Arezu's Predicament
locations.description:
*Arezu, a warden who serves in the Crimson Mirelands, has come to Jubilife Village. It seems she wants to talk to Commander Kamado about something.*  
**Steps:**
1. Follow Arezu to the [commander’s office](#loc=156476).
2. Complete enough research tasks to reach the rank of Second Star.
3. Head to the [Solaceon Ruins](#loc=156555), found in the Crimson Mirelands, to meet [Calaba](#loc=159263).
4. Track down the [shady bandits](#loc=159279) to reclaim the Wall Fragment they stole.
5. Return to the Solaceon Ruins to tell Volo that you’ve retrieved the Wall Fragment.
6. Give the Wall Fragment to Calaba inside the Solaceon Ruins.
7. Head to [Sludge Mound](#loc=156542) to find Ursaluna.
8. Report to [Commander Kamado](#loc=156476) to share what you learned about Ursaluna.
9. Ride on Ursaluna and follow the blue signals to sniff out [Arezu](#loc=159368) in the Crimson Mirelands.
10. Quell the frenzy of [Lilligant](#loc=157179), the Lady of the Ridge, at Brava Arena.
11. Report to [Commander Kamado](#loc=156476) that you have accomplished your mission.

**Next mission:** [#9: A New Mission](#loc=157770)

locations.title: #16: The Trial of Lake Acuity
locations.description:
*In order to obtain the Red Chain, you must clear the trial set by the Pokémon that protects Lake Acuity in the Alabaster Icelands.*  
**How to start:** Automatic  
**Steps:**
- Head to [Lake Acuity](#loc=156532), which can be found in the Alabaster Icelands.
- Enter the [cavern](#loc=156533) that appeared upon Lake Acuity.
- Battle the Pokémon lurking within Acuity Cavern (Alpha Hisuian Zoroark LV58).
- Complete Uxie’s trial in Acuity Cavern (answer is 60131).
- Head to the [Shrouded Ruins](#loc=156559), which lie in the Crimson Mirelands.

**Next mission:**
- [#14: The Trial of Lake Verity](#loc=157774)
- [#15: The Trial of Lake Valor](#loc=157779)
- Once all 3 Lake Trials are completed: [#17: Atop Mount Coronet](#loc=157780)

locations.title: #9: A New Mission
locations.description:
*Commander Kamado has welcomed in new arrivals to the village. You must continue studying the Pokémon of Hisui to ensure that all can live safely here.*  
**Steps:**
1. Go to the [commander’s office](#loc=156476) in Galaxy Hall to learn about your next mission.
2. Complete enough research tasks to reach the rank of Third Star.

**Next mission:** [#10: The Lordless Island](#loc=157746)

locations.title: #11: Scaling Perilious Heights
locations.description:
*Electrode, the Lord of the Hollow, has been driven into a frenzy by the strange lightning. Investigate the matter and find a way to quell its frenzy.*  
**Steps:**
1. Battle Adaman to demonstrate what you’re capable of.
2. Complete enough research tasks to reach the rank of Fourth Star.
3. Head to the Jubilife Village [training grounds](#loc=156482) to meet Ingo of the Pearl Clan.
4. Head to the [Coronet Highlands](#loc=156659) for your next mission.
5. Make your way up the mountain with [Ingo](#loc=159816).
6. Go inside [Wayward Cave](#loc=156454).
7. Pass through Wayward Cave to continue your journey up the mountain.
8. Make your way up the mountain with [Ingo](#loc=159830).
9. Defeat Melli in battle to clear your path.
10. Pass through the Ancient Quarry to continue your journey up the mountain.
11. Make your way up the mountain with [Ingo](#loc=159845).
12. Defeat Ingo in battle to prove your strength to him.
13. Scale the cliffs with Sneasler’s help to reach [Moonview Arena](#loc=156443).
14. Defeat Melli in battle to clear your path once again.
15. Quell the frenzy of [Electrode](#loc=157181), the Lord of the Hollow, at Moonview Arena.
16. Report to [Commander Kamado](#loc=156476) that you have accomplished your mission.

**Next mission:** [#12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra](#loc=157772)

locations.title: #12: The Slumbering Lord of the Tundra
locations.description:
*Avalugg, the Lord of the Tundra, has been driven into a frenzy by the strange lightning. Investigate the matter and find a way to quell his frenzy.*  
**Steps:**
1. Complete enough research tasks to reach the rank of Fifth Star.
2. Head to the [Alabaster Icelands](#loc=156473).
3. Go to meet [Gaeric](#loc=161138) of the Pearl Clan.
4. Defeat Gaeric in battle to prove your strength to him.
5. Speak with Sabi of the Diamond Clan.
6. Catch up to [Sabi](#loc=161158).
7. Make your way to the top floor of [Snowpoint Temple](#loc=156534).
8. Solve the stone statues’ puzzles and make your way to Snowpoint Temple’s top floor.
9. Prove your strength to Sabi on the top floor of Snowpoint Temple.
10. Prove your strength to Braviary on the roof of Snowpoint Temple.
11. Glide with Braviary to land [atop Avalugg’s Legacy](#loc=161175) and obtain a piece of Eternal Ice.
12. Make your way to [Icepeak Arena](#loc=156529).
13. Quell the frenzy of [Avalugg](#loc=157182), the Lord of the Tundra, at Icepeak Arena.
14. Report to [Commander Kamado](#loc=156476) that you have accomplished your mission.

**Next mission:** [#13: Disaster Looming](#loc=157773)

locations.title: #13: Disaster Looming
locations.description:
*The space-time rift has taken a strange and worrisome turn, and you’ve been banished from Jubilife Village. How are you to make your way on your own?*  
**Steps:**
1. Go outside and see what’s happening.
2. Seek out Lian.
3. Seek out Mai.
4. Speak to the person who dwells here at the retreat.
5. Complete the trials of the three lakes.
6. Choose whose help you want on the path ahead: Adaman of the Diamond Clan or Irida of the Pearl Clan.

**Next mission:** Can be done in any order
- [#14: The Trial of Lake Verity](#loc=157774)
- [#15: The Trial of Lake Valor](#loc=157779)
- [#16: The Trial of Lake Acuity](#loc=157765)

locations.title: #14: The Trial of Lake Verity
locations.description:
*In order to obtain the Red Chain, you must clear the trial set by the Pokémon that protects Lake Verity in the Obsidian Fieldlands.*  
**Steps:**
1. Head to [Lake Verity](#loc=156982), which can be found in the Obsidian Fieldlands.
2. Enter the [cavern](#loc=156489) that appeared upon Lake Verity.
3. Battle the Pokémon lurking within Verity Cavern (Alpha Hisuian Goodra LV58).
4. Complete Mesprit’s trial in Verity Cavern (there is no wrong answer).

**Next mission:**
- [#15: The Trial of Lake Valor](#loc=157779)
- [#16: The Trial of Lake Acuity](#loc=157765)
- Once all 3 Lake Trials are completed: [#17: Atop Mount Coronet](#loc=157780)

locations.title: #15: The Trial of Lake Valor
locations.description:
*In order to obtain the Red Chain, you must clear the trial set by the Pokémon that protects Lake Valor in the Crimson Mirelands.*  
**Steps:**
1. Head to [Lake Valor](#loc=156560), which can be found in the Crimson Mirelands.
2. Enter the [cavern](#loc=156554) that appeared upon Lake Valor.
3. Battle the Pokémon lurking within Valor Cavern (Alpha Overqwil LV58).
4. Try to hit Azelf with balms.
5. Don’t give up—keep trying to hit Azelf with balms.
6. Keep trying till the very end to hit Azelf with balms.

**Next mission:**
- [#14: The Trial of Lake Verity](#loc=157774)
- [#16: The Trial of Lake Acuity](#loc=157765)
- Once all 3 Lake Trials are completed: [#17: Atop Mount Coronet](#loc=157780)

locations.title: #17: Atop Mount Coronet
locations.description:
*Apparently, you’ve just missed Commander Kamado, who has led a force to Mount Coronet to take matters into his own hands. Hurry there to stop his reckless plan!*  
**Steps:**
1. Head to Mount Coronet’s peak in pursuit of Commander Kamado.
2. Talk sense into Commander Kamado at Mount Coronet’s peak.
3. Bring the Red Chain to the dais in the [Temple of Sinnoh](#loc=156722).
4. Approach the dais in the Temple of Sinnoh and catch almighty Sinnoh!
    - If you chose Adaman, you will face Dialga
    - If you chose Irida, you will face Palkia

**Next mission:** [#18: The Counterpart](#loc=157784)

locations.title: #18: The Counterpart
locations.description:
*There was a second almighty Sinnoh all along! But with the Red Chain no longer usable, you must find another method to catch this fearsome Pokémon.*  
**Steps:**
1. Head for the place where you can obtain the Origin Ore.
2. Defeat the Miss Fortune sisters and obtain a piece of Origin Ore.
3. Report back to Professor Laventon with the Origin Ore.
4. Prepare well, then make for the [Temple of Sinnoh](#loc=156722) once more.
    - Make sure you have the first Sinnoh in your party.
    - If you chose Adaman, you will face Palkia
    - If you chose Irina, you will face Dialga

**Next mission:** [#19: A New Day Dawns](#loc=157748)

locations.title: #20: The Researcher of Myths
locations.description:
*To flesh out your Pokédex, look into Legendary Pokémon with the help of the merchant Volo, who is very learned in the myths of the Hisui region.*  
**Steps:**
1. Meet Volo at the Heights Camp in the Obsidian Fieldlands.
2. Search for a plate in Grueling Grove in the Obsidian Fieldands.
3. Learn more from Cogita about the myths surrounding Arceus.
4. Collect the five plates that Cogita’s clues point toward.

**Next mission:** Can be done in any order:

locations.description:

**Steps:**

**Steps:**
1. Head for [Firespit Island](#loc=156593), which lies in the sea off the Cobalt Coastlands.
2. Enter the [Lava Dome Sanctum](#loc=156590), which lies off the Cobalt Coastlands.
3. Catch [Heatran](#loc=157796), which has appeared in the Lava Dome Sanctum.

locations.title: #23: The Plate of Moonview Arena
locations.description:
*Cogita has provided you with hints that might help you find more plates. One seems to be connected to a mysterious Pokémon appearing at Moonview Arena.*  
**Steps:**
1. Head to [Moonview Arena](#loc=156658), which lies in the Coronet Highlands.
2. Catch [Cresselia](#loc=157797), which is said to have appeared in Moonview Arena.

**Next mission:**

locations.title: #24: The Plate of Snowpoint Temple
locations.description:
*Cogita has provided you with hints that might help you find more plates. One seems to be connected to a giant sealed away beneath Snowpoint Temple.*  
**Steps:**
1. Open the door to the lower floors of [Snowpoint Temple](#loc=156534) in the Alabaster Icelands.
2. Investigate what lies at the bottom of Snowpoint Temple.
3. Catch [Regigigas](#loc=157802), which lies in wait at the bottom of Snowpoint Temple.

**Next mission:**

locations.title: #25: The Plate of Prelude Beach
locations.description:
*Cogita has provided you with hints that might help you find more plates. It seems Prelude Beach, which lies near Jubilife Village, has deep ties to Hisui’s ancient myths.*  
**Steps:**
1. Head to [Prelude Beach](#loc=157320), where Commander Kamado waits.
2. Defeat Commander Kamado in battle.

**Next mission:**
- [#21: The Plate of the Lakes](#loc=157790)
- [#22: The Plate of Firespit Island](#loc=157793)

locations.title: #26: Seeking the Remaining Plates
locations.description:
*With help from Cogita’s hints, you’ve gathered 17 plates in all. Search for the remaining plate with Volo’s aid.*  
**Steps:**
1. Return to Cogita and report your progress.
2. Give Cogita the items she requested of you (3x Wood).
3. Meet up with Volo at the Sacred Plaza, which lies near the Celestica Ruins in the Coronet Highlands.
4. Meet Volo at the Temple of Sinnoh atop Mount Coronet.

**Next mission:** [#27: The Deified Pokémon](#loc=157803)

locations.title: #27: The Deified Pokémon
locations.description:
*You have obtained the Azure Flute, which is said to be the key to meeting Arceus, the Pokémon spoken of in ancient myths. What will happen when you play it?*  
**Steps:**
1. Seek out all the Pokémon there are to meet, then play your flute upon the dais in the [Temple of Sinnoh](#loc=156722).
    - You will face Arceus

**Next mission:** None! Congratulations, you've completed the game!
